shared_elements: arms bent with hands brought toward the front of the body
elongated vertical body on a vertical field
circular/disc motif (rod terminal in A; disc on the torso in B)
justification: Both surfaces depict schematic frontal anthropomorphs with elongated bodies and arms bent so the hands come together in front of the torso, and both include a small disc-like element (a rod terminal in A, a chest disc in B), but these are near-universal ways of showing a human. The manner of depiction differs sharply: A is a pair of thin linear stick-figures, one holding a long handled implement, while B is a single massive body-block whose surface carries incised relief motifs (face, chest disc, banded torso, patterned head) with no companion figure or held object.
